definitions.gloss: accumulation (of effort or experience); building up
definitions.explanation: Steady accumulation over time, especially of small efforts, experience or achievements that add up to something larger.
Things placed one on top of another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ね⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Steady, accumulated effort is what matters.

notes:
Noun from {積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねる (to pile up, to accumulate). Sense 1 is by far the commoner, typically in praise of steady effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ね: accumulated effort
- ⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ね: day-by-day accumulation
- ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ね: accumulated experience

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{蓄積|ちくせき}→蓄積：14023_chikuseki⟧: accumulation; more formal, also for things like data, fatigue or wealth
- ⟦{継続|けいぞく}→継続：00213_keizoku⟧: continuation; the keeping-on, not the adding-up
